scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0099; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “The start is at nine.” and “It is a good start.” are natural short uses of the bounded noun sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently renders start as آغاز/شروع in the program context.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors distinguish the target noun from an opposite meaning and unrelated familiar language.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Both learner responses remain short and use familiar A1 frames.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second response changes from stating start time to evaluating the beginning.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities and outcome share the same bounded noun sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 noun sense.
